description: This file defines the Combinations class which provides methods to calculate combinations with and without repetition, used within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine's MathTrig functions.

classes.name: Combinations
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating combinations with and without repetition for use in spreadsheet formulas.

methods.name: withoutRepetition
methods.description: Calculates the number of combinations without repetition for a given number of objects and set size, supporting scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: withRepetition
methods.description: Calculates the number of combinations with repetition for given object and set counts, supporting scalar and array inputs.
